logic: Use viable frozen LTEE material whose evolutionary history is already fixed, while generating the registered MIC outcome only after public preregistration. This avoids waiting for a new long evolution experiment while preserving prospective outcome timing.
candidate_material_rule: Prefer LTEE populations/timepoints not used in the Donofrio dataset. Exact material remains ineligible until a metadata-only audit confirms that the registered target MIC values for that exact candidate have not been opened by ORI-C and the measuring team is independent.

official_archive_basis.fact: LTEE populations are cryo-archived every 500 generations and remain viable for revival

official_protocol_basis.fact: LTEE experimental protocols and resources are publicly documented

eligibility_gates: material identity fixed before outcome measurement
exact target MIC values not previously opened by ORI-C
analysis and success rule publicly registered before measurements
group/history identifiers fixed before MIC acquisition
raw MIC table hash frozen before ORI-C decoding
strict_success_rule_inherited: gain >= 5 %, bootstrap interval of gain > 0, permutation p <= 0.05
